Definition: Elasah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elasah is the name of four Israelites. In Ezra 10:22, the text says "and Elasah." The life behind the name is told on the Elasah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elasah matters because God knows His people by name, and Elasah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
